title: Kiss yori...
overview:
Aspiring novelist Masato met the voluptuous Chihiro on a beach one summer. They developed a relationship, but waned when they had to split up for work in the spring. Here Masato was tempted to take other relationships...but Chihiro wasn't giving this one up.

Kiss yori... is a dating simulator with static graphics. The way to advance in the game is by choosing an option among a list of several ones. There the player will take the role of an adolescent guy and should try to seduce as many attractive girls as possible.
